shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git show --stat HEAD | head -40

cat package.json src/*.tsx index.html; ls __agent_eval__; head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "landing\|page-constructor\|blog-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40
npm view @diplodoc/transform peerDependencies; npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@^8.24.1 2>&1 | tail -15

grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json; ls node_modules/@diplodoc 2>&1; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock ExtendedFeaturesBlock BannerBlock 2>&1 | head -60

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock ExtendedFeaturesBlock BannerBlock 2>&1 | head -60; grep '"version"' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json; ls node_modules/highlight.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo hljs-present
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; ls build/docs build/docs/* | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && sed -n 120,400p INDEX.md | grep -n -i -C4 "vite\|sass\|scss\|theme\|box-sizing" | head -120; echo ----; cat blocks/Header.md blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md blocks/Banner.md | head -250

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "vite-plugin-dynamic-import\|animated" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -90; grep -rn "animated" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Banner/Banner.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/AnimateBlock/AnimateBlock.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "backgroundColor\|color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js | head

grep -rn "AnimateContext\b.*createContext\|animated" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/context/animateContext/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "interface PageConstructorProviderProps" -A20 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; grep -n "^##\|theme\|ThemeProvider" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -40; ls node_modules/sass node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | head -3

grep -rln "AnimateContext.Provider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm | head; grep -n "interface PageConstructorProps" -A15 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts; grep -n "animated\|interface PageContent" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor.d.ts | head -30; sed -n 253,300p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | tail -3; cat vite.config.ts; grep -rn -i -B3 -A12 "dynamic-import\|dynamicImport" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -40; grep -n "interface ButtonProps\|ButtonTheme\b.*=" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "LocaleContextProps" -A5 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/context/localeContext/*.d.ts | head

grep -rn "enum Lang\|Lang =" -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "type Theme\b\|Theme =" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts | head -3; npm install @diplodoc/transform@^4.78.12 2>&1 | grep -i "added\|up to date\|ERR"

grep -rn "Lang\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/context/localeContext/localeContext.d.ts | head -3; grep -rln "export declare enum Lang\|export type Lang\|export { Lang\|Lang }" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export declare enum Theme\|export type Theme " node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models --include=*.d.ts | head
sed -n 1,10p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts; grep -n "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.js

grep -n "models\|export \*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "useThemeValue\|useTheme\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts
grep -n "@import\|@use" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.scss
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | grep -iv "deprecat\|sass-lang\|│\|╷\|╵\|@import\|^ *node_modules\|migrator" | tail -20

ls node_modules/url 2>&1 | head -2; npm install url 2>&1 | grep -i "added\|ERR"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | grep -iv "deprecat\|sass-lang\|│\|╷\|╵\|@import\|^ *node_modules\|migrator" | tail -15
ls -la dist/assets; grep -o "process\.env\.[A-Z_]*\|\bBuffer\.\w*\|require(\"[a-z]*\")" dist/assets/*.js | sort | uniq -c | head; git status --short
grep -o ".\{120\}Buffer\.from.\{60\}\|.\{150\}require(\"util\").\{40\}" dist/assets/index-Dtt_Q0by.js; cat .gitignore
rm -rf dist && git diff package.json
